question: What division of eightfold groups is sought to be fully known?
premises: A division exists in groups of eight
The speaker seeks full knowledge of it
The knowledge is sought in an endless manner
inference: The speaker seeks to know fully the division of the eight groups of eight
uncertainties: The exact sense of anantathā in this context is unclear
plain_english: I wish to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight groups of eight.
